description: Generate image drafts through ReqLLM, using OpenAI as the first verified provider, then reuse the durable staging and DelveTown publication pipeline. A live probe on October 5, 2026 succeeded with openai:gpt-image-1-mini and returned valid PNG bytes with usage metadata. Generation must be budgeted, auditable, idempotent at the request boundary, and separate from publication approval.
title: Add controlled ReqLLM image generation
